title: Deterministic Fault Proof Specification (AST Invariant Violation & WASM Trap Assertion)
description: Cryptographically authenticated fault proof format verifying reproducible state-machine failures, abstract syntax tree (AST) invariant violations, kinematic boundary exceedances, or unhandled execution traps. Triggers an immediate suspension of the optimistic timelock countdown within the on-chain escrow layer (AER Section 4.4.3).

schema_version.description: Semantic versioning string of this formal schema specification (e.g. 1.0.0).

task_id.description: 32-byte cryptographic identifier of the disputed escrow contract.

reporter_node_id.description: EVM address of the asserting entity (client, automated referee, or watchtower node).

worker_node_id.description: EVM address of the respondent executor accused of submitting non-conforming execution outputs.

defect_type.description: Deterministic, non-subjective failure category verifiable via an isolated sandbox or formal grammar engine.

source_artifact_hash.description: SHA-256 cryptographic digest of the exact artifact triggering the deterministic trap or assertion.

error_code.description: Canonical runtime error code (e.g. WASM_TRAP_UNREACHABLE, AST_SYNTAX_ERROR_EOF, KINEMATIC_TORQUE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED).

reproduction_trace.description: Deterministic sequence trace, bytecode instruction offset, or line/column coordinate reproducing the failure.

evaluator_version.description: Standardized canonical runtime environment identifier (e.g. wasmtime-21.0.0, cpython-3.12-ast).

deterministic_evaluator_digest.description: SHA-256 binary digest of the deterministic referee engine or WebAssembly verification kernel.

timestamp.description: Unix epoch timestamp in seconds recording proof compilation.

reporter_signature.description: 65-byte ECDSA cryptographic signature generated by the reporter authorizing the dispute submission.
